purpose: Review a finite issuer insurance, self-insurance, claim-realization and risk-transfer disclosure domain before opening source rows, policy or filing text, insurance values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.cash_conversion_company_type_boundary: The cash-conversion contract's insurance company-type label classifies reporting templates; it is not issuer policy coverage, premium, deductible, retention, claim or recovery evidence.
repository_evidence.operational_incident_boundary: Campaign166 separately froze underlying recall, production/safety and cyber incident states. Insurance or self-insurance is a financing and loss-allocation state, but an incident mention cannot be relabeled as proof of coverage or recovery.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current annual-report description of insurance arrangements cannot be projected backward without policy inception, renewal, cancellation, endorsement, limit, exclusion and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact issuer filing, exchange announcement, insurer confirmation, court or regulator source with immutable bytes and stable document identifier
first-public timestamp, trading-session availability, policy inception, effective date, expiry, renewal, cancellation, endorsement, correction and supersession chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, facility, asset, product, geography, counterparty and policyholder or beneficiary mapping without current-state leakage
policy identity, insurer, coinsurer, reinsurer, captive, broker, guarantor and self-insured layer without double counting
peril taxonomy separating property, business interruption, cyber, product liability, environmental, credit, directors and officers, key-person and other cover
gross and net limits, sublimits, aggregate limits, deductibles, retentions, waiting periods, attachment points, exclusions and uncovered layers
premium, fee, collateral, reserve, captive contribution, currency, tax, accounting and consolidation semantics
claim occurrence, discovery, notification, acceptance, denial, reservation, litigation, gross loss, insured loss, paid recovery and receivable timing
incident identity linking without using the later claim outcome or revised loss estimate before it became public
missing, undisclosed, confidential, unknown, not-applicable, expired, cancelled, true zero coverage and zero recovery semantics without favorable absence coding
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, insurer and issuer identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser, identity, timing, unit, policy-layer, claim-linkage and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: property_business_interruption_or_catastrophe_coverage_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer risk-transfer arrangement for physical assets, production interruption or catastrophe losses.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted history freezes policy identity, covered assets and perils, gross/net limits, deductibles, waiting periods, exclusions, inception/expiry, endorsements, insurer mapping and full 2019-2023 issuer coverage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: liability_cyber_product_or_environmental_insurance_coverage_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer liability-transfer arrangement for data, product, environmental, management or other third-party claims.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Covered entities, claims-made versus occurrence basis, retroactive dates, sublimits, exclusions, renewals, confidential terms, first availability and comparable full-market disclosure are not frozen.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: insurance_claim_acceptance_recovery_or_denial_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known realization of insurance recovery, denial or dispute after an issuer loss event.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository has no accepted point-in-time claim identity linking occurrence, notification, reservation, acceptance, denial, litigation, gross loss, insured loss, receivable and cash recovery without later-outcome leakage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: self_insurance_captive_retention_or_risk_transfer_mix_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer allocation of loss-bearing capacity among deductibles, self-insurance, captives, commercial insurance, guarantees and reinsurance.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Retention layers, captive ownership, collateral, intercompany transfer, policy stacking, currency, consolidation, renewal and first-public histories are absent from a complete accepted local contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: insurer_company_type_cashflow_provision_or_incident_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing company classification, accounting line, reserve, provision or operating incident relabeled as issuer insurance protection.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Insurance company type, cash-flow values, provisions and Campaign166 incidents do not establish a non-insurer issuer's policy coverage, retained layer or recoverable claim; renaming them would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: coverage_adequacy_claim_ratio_recency_direction_or_window_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transform of insurance coverage, premium, retention or recovery against assets, revenue, losses, incidents or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher/lower direction, adequacy denominator, claim ratio, retention threshold, peril subset, recency, renewal window or peer benchmark before base-source admission would multiply hypotheses; more insurance can signal either resilience or greater underlying risk.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_enterprise_insurance_breadth_gap_severity_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across property, liability, claim-realization and retained-risk families.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or selecting weights, gaps, ranks, severity proxies, interactions, filters or models would expand the search before any component has a complete source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct enterprise insurance and retained-risk states remain deferred at source admission; accounting or incident relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven decisions in the Campaign172 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
